professionalSummary.text: Web Frontend Engineer with expertise in building and maintaining warehouse scheduling applications, specifically the dock-schedule board and shift planner using Vue.js.
professionalSummary.witness: Built and looked after the dock-schedule board and shift planner in the warehouse scheduling app (Vue): the drag-and-drop slot editor, the overlap highlighting for shifts and the printable day view planners asked for.

professionalSummary.text: Proven ability to maintain and extend frontend test suites, ensuring component and browser tests remain green with each change.
professionalSummary.witness: Looked after the Vitest component tests and the Playwright browser tests; a board-render smoke test I added now has to pass before a release can go out.

professionalSummary.text: Reduced client-side error rate from 4.1 to 0.9 errors per thousand sessions through a state-management rewrite, measured against the published baseline.
professionalSummary.witness: The schedule board's client-side error rate fell from 4.1 errors per thousand sessions to 0.9 after the state-management rewrite, measured by the application's error monitoring over the following two months against the published baseline of 4.1.

experienceHighlights.text: Developed and maintained the dock-schedule board and shift planner, including drag-and-drop slot editor, overlap highlighting for shifts, and printable day view planners.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and looked after the dock-schedule board and shift planner in the warehouse scheduling app (Vue): the drag-and-drop slot editor, the overlap highlighting for shifts and the printable day view planners asked for.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained and extended Vitest component tests and Playwright browser tests, adding a mandatory board-render smoke test for releases.
experienceHighlights.witness: Looked after the Vitest component tests and the Playwright browser tests; a board-render smoke test I added now has to pass before a release can go out.

experienceHighlights.text: Reduced client-side error rate from 4.1 to 0.9 errors per thousand sessions through a state-management rewrite, measured against the published baseline.
experienceHighlights.witness: The schedule board's client-side error rate fell from 4.1 errors per thousand sessions to 0.9 after the state-management rewrite, measured by the application's error monitoring over the following two months against the published baseline of 4.1.

experienceHighlights.text: Collaborated with backend team on API changes, adapting frontend to approved endpoints while documenting approvals.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took API changes through the backend team's review, where the backend lead had the final say on endpoints; my side was adapting the board and planner to whatever was approved.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented release limitations and maintained on-call hand-over sheets for frontend engineers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the app's release write-ups, which recorded among other things that the slot editor could not yet handle multi-day slots, and the hand-over sheet the frontend on-call engineer reads.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Twelve-week error monitoring export showing reduction in client-side errors from 4.1 to 0.9 errors per thousand sessions, with baseline and rewrite release marked.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: a twelve-week export from the error monitoring tool (weekly errors per thousand sessions, with the baseline and the rewrite release marked) plus the Playwright smoke test; pipeline run numbers are included so the entries can be traced.

skills.witness: Built and looked after the dock-schedule board and shift planner in the warehouse scheduling app (Vue): the drag-and-drop slot editor, the overlap highlighting for shifts and the printable day view planners asked for.
Looked after the Vitest component tests and the Playwright browser tests; a board-render smoke test I added now has to pass before a release can go out.
